Source & how it works

A photo of Plot, turned into points, blocks and lines using estimated depth. Turning may reveal gaps or stretched edges.

Photo sets stay on your device; the controls run locally.

Personal experiment by Darcy Rim, made with Codex. Not an official Plot or Nela tool.

Read the code · Try a small edit.

Source photo: Plot 田 / Google Maps. View original source.

Depth model: Depth Anything V2 Small (Yang et al., 2024).

GIF encoder: gifenc by Matt DesLauriers (MIT). Encoder license.

Prepare other photos with a depth estimate for each image.

Learn more: RGB-D tutorial by Open3D.
